title: Analyst lens: Sanofi vaccines in Taiwan

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: RSV volume roughly quadrupled week on week. Sanlih reports 16 infants infected in a cluster at Changhua Christian Hospital's postpartum care centre within 20 days. Parent posts discuss wanting newborn RSV antibodies at birth and RSV shots checked at late-pregnancy visits. No item names Beyfortus or nirsevimab.
products.implication: Infant RSV is moving from a parent-forum topic to a news story about care settings. That invites questions from regulators and the public on how newborns in postpartum centres are protected and who pays.
products.action: Prepare a factual briefing on infant RSV burden and prevention options for health authorities and clinical societies, and set up issue readiness for media or legislative questions on postpartum-centre outbreaks. Make no public product messaging.
products.signal_zh: RSV聲量較前週約增為4倍。三立報導彰化基督教醫院產後護理之家20天內16名嬰兒群聚感染。家長貼文討論希望新生兒出生即施打RSV抗體，以及孕晚期產檢時詢問RSV疫苗。無任何內容提及Beyfortus或nirsevimab。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒RSV正從家長論壇話題轉為照護機構相關新聞，可能引發主管機關與民眾質疑產後護理之家如何保護新生兒及費用由誰負擔。
products.action_zh: 為衛生主管機關及臨床醫學會準備嬰兒RSV疾病負擔與預防選項的事實簡報，並針對產後護理之家疫情的媒體或立法院詢問做好議題準備。不進行任何公開產品宣傳。

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), public enhanced flu programme
products.signal: High-dose and enhanced flu volume fell sharply from launch week. Liberty Times opinion columns frame the first public enhanced flu vaccines as a public-health strategy for a super-aged society. A fact-check states the public enhanced flu vaccine is not mRNA. Separately, articles promote a recombinant flu vaccine for high-risk older adults.
products.implication: The enhanced-vaccine story is shifting from launch news to policy evaluation. That comes as media report five-year-high severe flu counts concentrated in older adults, which could prompt debate on widening priority beyond long-term-care residents. The mRNA rumour shows enhanced vaccines can be pulled into COVID-19 misinformation.
products.action: Assemble policy-level evidence on the long-term-care roll-out to support expert and agency dialogue on future eligibility. Keep a factual reference on vaccine technology ready for fact-checkers if the mRNA rumour resurfaces.
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），公費加強型流感計畫
products.signal_zh: 高劑量及加強型流感疫苗聲量較上市週大幅下降。自由時報評論專欄將首度公費加強型流感疫苗定位為超高齡社會的公衛策略。一則事實查核指出公費加強型流感疫苗並非mRNA。另有文章推廣適用高風險長者的重組流感疫苗。
products.implication_zh: 加強型疫苗議題正從上市新聞轉向政策評估。同時媒體報導流感重症數創五年新高且集中於長者，可能引發將優先對象擴大至長照機構住民以外的討論。mRNA謠言顯示加強型疫苗可能被捲入COVID-19錯誤訊息。
products.action_zh: 彙整長照機構接種推動的政策層級證據，以支持與專家及主管機關就未來接種資格的對話。備妥疫苗技術的事實參考資料，以便mRNA謠言再起時提供事實查核機構。
who_zh: 老年醫學及感染症醫學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Little this week. Volume is small though up from a very low base. One post invokes pertussis and tetanus deaths in the pre-vaccine era to rebut scepticism, and another user lists pertussis among shots received during pregnancy. No official or news item addresses Tdap.
products.implication: Pertussis appears mainly as part of parents' broader prenatal vaccine checklist. The RSV postpartum cluster may raise general interest in newborn protection.
products.action: Monitor only. Keep maternal-immunisation evidence current for clinical societies in case newborn-protection questions broaden beyond RSV.
products.sub_zh: 百日咳保護，含孕婦接種
products.signal_zh: 本週聲量很少。聲量雖小，但從極低基期上升。一則貼文以疫苗問世前的百日咳及破傷風死亡案例駁斥疑苗論，另一名網友列出孕期接種的疫苗包括百日咳。無官方或新聞內容提及Tdap。
products.implication_zh: 百日咳主要出現在家長較廣泛的產前疫苗清單中。RSV產後護理之家群聚事件可能提升大眾對新生兒保護的整體關注。
products.action_zh: 僅持續監測。為臨床醫學會更新孕婦接種證據，以防新生兒保護議題從RSV擴大。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.signal: Thin. The only brand-specific item is Taiwan CDC's 1 October launch notice confirming Novavax is supplied in the public programme. Overall COVID-19 volume fell week on week. Unbranded posts spread safety claims (brain damage, heart disease, deaths, 'experimental' vaccines), and one high-engagement post describes a suspected adverse event; none names Novavax.
products.implication: Exposure is limited to the general COVID-19 safety climate. Any unbranded claim could still produce brand questions from clinics or media.
products.action: Keep holding statements and safety-monitoring references ready for health bureau or media enquiries. Make sure the public programme's frontline guidance on the protein-based option is accurate, and route adverse-event questions to pharmacovigilance.
products.signal_zh: 聲量稀少。唯一提及品牌的內容是疾管署10月1日開打公告，確認公費計畫提供Novavax。COVID-19整體聲量較前週下降。未提品牌的貼文散布安全性說法（腦損傷、心臟病、死亡、「實驗性」疫苗），一則高互動貼文描述疑似不良事件；均未提及Novavax。
products.implication_zh: 曝險僅限於整體COVID-19疫苗安全性氛圍。但任何未提品牌的說法仍可能引發診所或媒體的品牌相關詢問。
products.action_zh: 備妥因應聲明及安全監測參考資料，以回應衛生局或媒體詢問。確保公費計畫對第一線關於蛋白質疫苗選項的指引正確，並將不良事件問題轉交藥物安全監視單位。

issues.title: Second stage of public flu programme widens eligibility
issues.note: With uptake already above last year and a user reporting no flu vaccine left when asked, expect questions on stock and allocation between the public programme and clinics' self-pay supply.
issues.title_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段擴大接種對象
issues.note_zh: 接種量已高於去年，且有網友表示詢問時流感疫苗已無存貨，預期將出現公費與診所自費疫苗庫存及分配的相關詢問。

issues.title: Scrutiny of infant RSV protection after postpartum-centre cluster
issues.note: The Changhua cluster could draw regulator or legislator attention to infant RSV prevention in care settings. Prepare factual briefings and spokesperson readiness.
issues.title_zh: 產後護理之家群聚事件後嬰兒RSV保護受檢視
issues.note_zh: 彰化群聚事件可能引起主管機關或立委關注照護機構的嬰兒RSV預防。應準備事實簡報並做好發言人準備。

issues.title: COVID-19 safety misinformation spilling onto flu vaccines
issues.note: Recycled COVID-19 harm claims are circulating, and a rumour falsely tied the public enhanced flu vaccine to mRNA. Coordinate with fact-checkers rather than respond publicly.
issues.title_zh: COVID-19安全性錯誤訊息波及流感疫苗
issues.note_zh: 重炒的COVID-19疫苗危害說法持續流傳，另有謠言錯誤地將公費加強型流感疫苗與mRNA連結。應與事實查核機構協調，而非公開回應。

self_pay.title: Self-pay mentioned but not quantified
self_pay.note: Rollout guides, a local health item and a doctor interview note that self-paid flu and COVID-19 vaccination is an option. None gives prices, brands or clinic stock levels.
self_pay.note_zh: 接種指南、一則地方衛生消息及一則醫師訪談指出可自費接種流感及COVID-19疫苗，但均未提供價格、品牌或診所庫存。

self_pay.title: Isolated stock-out report
self_pay.note: One user posts that no flu vaccine was left when they asked. The post does not say whether it was public or self-pay stock, so it is a thin signal to watch.
self_pay.note_zh: 一名網友貼文表示詢問時流感疫苗已無存貨。貼文未說明是公費或自費庫存，屬需留意的薄弱訊號。

self_pay.title: No self-pay data on enhanced flu, RSV antibodies or Tdap
self_pay.note: No item this week covers self-pay availability or price for enhanced flu, infant RSV antibodies or Tdap. Parent posts show interest in newborn RSV antibodies and prenatal pertussis shots but say nothing on cost or access.
self_pay.title_zh: 無加強型流感、RSV抗體或Tdap的自費資料
self_pay.note_zh: 本週無內容涉及加強型流感疫苗、嬰兒RSV抗體或Tdap的自費供應或價格。家長貼文顯示對新生兒RSV抗體及產前百日咳疫苗有興趣，但未提及費用或取得管道。

self_pay.title: Health coins and self-paid shots unclear
self_pay.note: Coverage credits health coins with boosting the joint campaign, citing over 550,000 people redeeming 162 million coins. It does not show how much of this involves self-paid shots.
self_pay.title_zh: 健康幣與自費接種關聯不明
self_pay.note_zh: 報導認為健康幣帶動聯合接種，指逾55萬人兌換1.62億枚健康幣，但未顯示其中涉及自費接種的比例。
